issues.where: storm eye at centre (crops A, Q in image-06/07)
issues.what: the eye has stray electric-blue pixels and specks that look like compression or shader noise, and the white cloud fragments inside the eye have hard, cut-out edges
issues.fix: remove the saturated blue speckle, re-render the eye with real cloud detail, and blend the inner cloud fragments into the vortex

issues.where: lower right clouds (crops V, W, E in image-06/08)
issues.what: clouds break into blocky square patches; you can see the tile or texture blocks at native size
issues.fix: raise the cloud texture resolution or filtering so the cloud edges are continuous rather than made of square blocks

issues.where: whole frame, especially the cloud bands (crops C, G, L, R, M)
issues.what: a heavy radial or zoom blur smears everything into streaks; the cloud edges turn into comb-like smears and nothing is sharp anywhere, so the frame looks like a stretched low-res texture rather than a real close-up
issues.fix: cut back the zoom blur a lot, keep a sharp focal area around the eye, and add true high-frequency cloud detail

issues.where: upper right limb and sky (crops M, N in image-07)
issues.what: the stars and sky at the limb are a warm, grainy smudge that does not match the starfield in image-01, and the limb line is soft
issues.fix: use the same crisp starfield and a clean atmospheric falloff at the limb

issues.where: dark lower left, rings and night side (crops T, D, O in image-03/04)
issues.what: a faint square grid or tile pattern and slight banding show in the near-black gradient
issues.fix: add dither or noise to the dark gradient and remove the tile seams in the background layer

issues.what: the rings are thin, ghostly streaks that look painted on rather than solid, and they fade out unevenly
issues.fix: give the rings a consistent structure and opacity, and make them cast or take shadow from the planet

issues.what: the moon's surface is smooth and slightly airbrushed, with little crater detail and a weak terminator
issues.fix: add higher-resolution surface detail and a sharper day-night boundary

issues.where: left, central, and terminator globe regions (crops image-14.png A, B, H; image-15.png J, O, P, Q)
issues.what: most of the planet cloud deck is heavily smeared and directionally blurred into soft, airbrushed streaks with linear comb-like stepping near the terminator, leaving only a small patch near the upper-right vortex sharp
issues.fix: use a uniformly sharp high-resolution spherical cloud map across the full globe without directional blur or stretched streaks

issues.where: ring system on right half and dark lower-right limb intersection (crops image-14.png C, E, F, I; image-15.png M, Q, R; image-16.png V)
issues.what: at native size the rings break into short, straight parallel brushstrokes that cut across the curved ring plane rather than following concentric orbital arcs, and fade out in a fuzzy gap near the dark planet limb
issues.fix: generate ring striations and particle density along true elliptical orbital coordinates and occult them cleanly against a crisp planet silhouette

issues.where: opaque blue and shadowed cloud deck across the planet surface (crops image-10.png A, D, E; image-11.png N, O, P, R; image-12.png S, U)
issues.what: stray pinpoint white star-like dots are scattered directly on top of the opaque cloud deck and dark storm bands where background stars cannot appear
issues.fix: mask the starfield strictly outside the opaque planet disc and remove stray white pixel specks from the cloud layer

issues.where: sunlit upper-left/upper-right limb and shadowed right limb (crops image-14.png A, G; image-15.png J, K, L, Q)
issues.what: a thin bright cyan rim line separates from a soft outer halo, terminates abruptly partway down the dark right limb, and has undimmed pinpoint stars sitting directly on the bright atmospheric edge
issues.fix: replace the doubled rim-and-halo edge with a smooth atmospheric scattering falloff that tapers naturally into the nightside and attenuates stars behind dense limb haze

issues.where: lower-right foreground end of the white cloud band (crops image-10.png E; image-12.png U)
issues.what: the near-camera cloud wisps become soft and smeared compared with the crisp mid-ground cloud tops
issues.fix: maintain crisp high-frequency cloud filament detail through the lower-right foreground or use physically consistent depth-of-field across the entire near plane

issues.where: bright atmospheric limb band and sky above right limb (crops image-10.png C; image-11.png J, K)
issues.what: several pinpoint stars shine unattenuated inside the bright lower atmospheric haze band and the brightest star in tile C/K shows a slightly smudged asymmetric blob
issues.fix: attenuate background stars proportionally to atmospheric optical depth near the horizon and render bright star point-spread functions cleanly
